anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
verdict: needs-work
addresses-problem: partial — the design covers all four widgets rows and correctly hands the email to acme/mailer, but the Export-click row is dispositioned `venue: prd`, so it is only verified on production.
findings:
- [blocker] scope @ "Clicking Export downloads a CSV. - venue: prd - a human clicks Export on the live site" — A `venue:` naming `prd` is not allowed. It also contradicts the Goal ("This change delivers all four widgets rows"), because this row's proof is pushed to a human on the live site. → Change the row to `in-scope`. Verify it with the request test already listed in Verification (Content-Disposition attachment, filename="widgets.csv", text/csv UTF-8) plus the collection-page rendering test that checks the Export link targets GET /widgets/export.csv. — probed: none
- [minor] ambiguity @ "Run the 10000-widget benchmark for the 60s row when in-scope." — "when in-scope" is conditional, yet the row is unconditionally `in-scope`. An implementer could skip the benchmark. → Change to "Run the 10000-widget benchmark and assert the complete response arrives within 60s." Also name where it runs (e.g., a CI job or test file). — probed: none
- [minor] gap @ "Mailer owns delivery of the export-ready email and download link" — The cross-repo contract is implicit. Mailer needs a stable download URL and needs to know whether the link requires an authenticated session, and the spec states neither. → State that GET /widgets/export.csv is the stable link mailer embeds. Also state that it requires the user's normal authenticated session, or describe the token scheme if it does not. — probed: none
lean: nothing to cut
